Bill.BriefDescription: Directing the University of Washington to contract with private entities in the provision of student food services.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to directing the University of Washington tocontract with private entities in the provision of student foodservices; adding a new section to chapter 28B.20 RCW; adding a newsection to chapter 41.06 RCW; providing an effective date; providingexpiration dates; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) It is the legislature's intent to conduct a pilot test todetermine whether providing student food services through contractswith local restaurants, restaurant franchises, or other private foodpurveyors can be costeffective and have a positive impact on studentsatisfaction with food services. (2) Beginning July 1, 2003, the board of regents of the Universityof Washington shall designate a portion of student food services to beprovided through contracts under this section. The designated portionof student food services must be of a size sufficient to permit a validcomparison over at least a fouryear period between contracted foodservices and food services provided directly by the university. p. 1 HB 2031 (3) Using a competitive process in compliance with RCW 28B.10.029,the board shall contract with local restaurants, restaurant franchises,or other private food purveyors to provide the portion of student foodservices designated under subsection (2) of this section. The boardshall structure the solicitation of contracts in such a way to permitmultiple contractors to provide the student food services. Thecontracts under this section may not extend beyond June 30, 2008. (4) The joint legislative audit and review committee shall conducta performance audit of the implementation of this section to determinewhether the pilot test resulted in cost savings and had an impact onstudent satisfaction with food services and shall report to thelegislature by December 1, 2007, on the results of the audit. Theperformance audit must include a student satisfaction survey. (5) This section expires July 1, 2008.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.06 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) This chapter does not prohibit the University of Washingtonfrom providing a portion of student food services through contractswith private entities as required under section 1 of this act. (2) This section expires July 1, 2008.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectJuly 1, 2003.
